scoring.source: V0 §§6.3.4, 6.4 and 6.5, Table 6-2. See G409 for simultaneous control, G412 for CORAL launch location and the scoring criteria for each target.

inventory.distribution: 6 on field marks. Up to 6 robot preloads. The remainder is split between alliance stations (57–60 per alliance).
12 on reef branches and 6 on field marks. Processor transfers can make a piece available for another scoring action.

fieldMap.basis: V0 §§5.1–5.6, 6.3 and Figure 6-2. One alliance frame is mirrored for the other. Start X derives from the starting line and reef dimensions. Three lateral starting slots, pickup and scoring approach coordinates are illustrative robot-center positions in inches. Opening AUTO routes can also use a preload. Actual team routes and arrival times are unknown.

limits.source: R101–R104. Rectangular robot perimeter excluding bumpers and height in starting configuration.

geometrySource: §5.3, pp. 23–24. Each reef is centered across the field. Its modeled center is 144 in plus half its width from the alliance wall. The rings mark elevations only.
omissions: Corners, barge, stations, game pieces, bumpers and deployed mechanisms are omitted. Field outlines and height rings support scale comparisons only.
